result.topic_en: A heavily corrected draft letter to a 'Geheimer Hofrath' thanking him for an honour from the Göttingen Society and sending Dedekind's edition of a paper from Dirichlet's Nachlass together with Riemann's own paper; below it are logarithmic calculations of the speed of sound (about 332 m) and the ratio of specific heats (about 1.409).

methods.what: Speed-of-sound computation as a square root of a product of physical constants (pressure in terms of mercury height, gravity, density ratio)
Logarithmic calculation: summing logarithms, halving to obtain a square root, giving sound speed about 332.44 m/s
Inverse calculation from measured sound speed (Martins and Bravais) to the ratio of specific heats: double the log of the speed, subtract the log of the Newtonian value, and take the antilog
